mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UB_MEMBER ( member_id, member_pw, member_name, member_nickname, member_phone, member_gender, survey_number, member_type, member_state, survey_write, file_number ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPw}, #{memberName}, #{memberNickname}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberGender}, null, 'NODECIDED', '계정 활성화', 'N', null )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UB_MEMBER ub WHERE ub.member_id = #{memberId} AND ub.member_state = '계정 삭제'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UB_MATCHING WHERE (mentor_number = #{memberNumber} OR mentee_number = #{memberNumber}) AND matching_state = '매칭중'
SELECT MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_GENDER, MEMBER_PHONE FROM UB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.MEMBER_GENDER, M.MEMBER_PHONE, F.FILE_NAME AS MEMBER_IMG, M.FILE_NUMBER FROM UB_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UB_FILE F ON M.FILE_NUMBER = F.FILE_NUMBER WHERE M.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE UB_MEMBER SET survey_number = #{surveyNumber}, survey_write = 'Y' WHERE member_number = #{memberNumber}
